name: Cauld Lad

attributes.attribute: gave the Cauld Lad a cloak
laid the fairy and ended the help

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Cauld Lad is a figure in British folklore. He is a form of the brownie. He shivered naked but he helped around the house. The worried householder gave him a cloak. That gift laid the fairy, and the Cauld Lad vanished. People met him rarely in Britain.

okr.objective: Cauld Lad is a British brownie who vanished after a cloak.
